description: This file is a PHP script for rendering and managing the user list view in a CRM system, specifically for the vtiger CRM platform. It handles user access permissions, fetches user data from the database, manages sorting, pagination, and displays the user list along with status messages.

classes.name: ListViewSession
classes.description: A class that manages session data related to ListView features such as current page, sorting order, and sort by parameters.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: A Smarty template engine integration class used for rendering HTML views.

methods.name: getListQuery
methods.description: Constructs the SQL query to retrieve user records for listing.

methods.name: fixPostgresQuery
methods.description: Adjusts SQL query syntax for PostgreSQL database compatibility.

methods.name: UserCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of user records.
